reasons.long-shot-red: +2{p} with an aim counter is the biggest payoff for Crow's Nest counters and pushes power well above base for Bolt'n' Shot's go again + reload.
reasons.head-shot-red: +2{p} when put face-up into arsenal triggers off Azalea's ability, Death Dealer, and any arsenal loader, simultaneously fueling Bolt'n' Shot.
reasons.over-flex-red: +4{p} with Reload and go again is the premier pump that makes arrows exceed base power while refilling the arsenal.
reasons.fletch-a-red-tail-red: +4{p} and red cards get -1{d} defending is the highest-impact pump for this red-heavy arrow deck.
reasons.hook-blue: Puts an arrow from the top of deck face-up into arsenal with +1{p}, chaining Crow's Nest aim counters and Bolt'n' Shot triggers.
reasons.blessing-of-focus-red: Start-of-turn opt 3 and arrow into arsenal with an aim counter pre-loads the entire engine every turn.
reasons.silver-the-tip-red: Digs 4 cards deep for an arrow into arsenal when empty, chaining directly into Death Dealer or a Crow's Nest aim counter.
reasons.line-blue: Puts an arrow face-up into arsenal with go again, setting up aim counters and extending action chains.
reasons.sinker-blue: Puts an arrow face-up into arsenal with overpower, another cheap enabler for Crow's Nest and Bolt'n' Shot.
reasons.entangling-shot-red: Taps a hero when put face-up into arsenal from Azalea or Death Dealer, adding strong tempo to the existing loop.
